column1: # Module 08 — how the web works. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What is the page-load journey, in order? {{c1::URL → DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP request → edge/gate/origin → response → render}} — repeated per asset.
What is the anatomy of a URL? {{c1::scheme://host/path?query}} — protocol · machine-by-name · thing-there · options.
What does DNS do? {{c1::Turns names into numeric IP addresses (the phone book)}}; by hand: {{c2::nslookup}}.
Whose IPs answer for www.leedspunjabisociety.com? {{c1::Cloudflare's — the edge, not the Vercel origin}}.
What is TCP, in one sentence? {{c1::A reliable, ordered, two-way pipe to a numbered port}} — 443 for HTTPS; a phone call, not a postcard.
What two things does TLS give you? {{c1::Secrecy (encryption)}} + {{c2::identity (a certificate vouched by a trusted authority)}}.
What does HSTS commit a browser to? {{c1::HTTPS-only for max-age seconds}} — preload = baked into browsers.
What are the HTTP status families? 2xx {{c1::worked}} · 3xx {{c2::go elsewhere}} · 4xx {{c3::you erred}} · 5xx {{c4::server erred}}.
What do HTTP 307/308 promise that 301/302 don't? {{c1::The method won't change on the redirect (a POST stays a POST)}}.
What are your site's two real redirects, and why do they differ? vercel.app → {{c1::308 permanent (address moved for good)}}; /dashboard logged-out → {{c2::307 temporary (log in and it serves)}}.
What is the HTTP Age header the tell of? {{c1::A cache served you — seconds the copy sat on the edge; the origin never woke}}.
What are the session cookie's three protective flags? {{c1::HttpOnly (scripts can't read it)}} · {{c2::Secure (HTTPS only)}} · {{c3::SameSite (other sites can't ride it)}}.
Why re-check auth AFTER the proxy gate? {{c1::Forged requests skip gates — the check beside the data is the one they can't skip}}.
What is a CDN? {{c1::Cache servers near users answering for the origin}} — vending machines stocked from one warehouse.
What is your site's serving chain? {{c1::Cloudflare (DNS + edge cache)}} in front of {{c2::Vercel (the Next.js origin)}}.
Which one header revealed your site's backend? {{c1::CSP connect-src *.supabase.co}} (+ its live websocket).
What does X-Frame-Options: DENY defend against? {{c1::Clickjacking — nobody may iframe the site}}.
What do curl's -I, -L and -v flags do? {{c1::Headers only (HEAD)}} · {{c2::follow redirects}} · {{c3::narrate the whole conversation}}.
The docs said vercel.app but the wire said the custom domain — what is the lesson? {{c1::Trust the wire over the docs — docs drift, evidence doesn't}}.
